boundaries.statement: Named vendor import adapters remain incremental after launch under OD-33; generic CSV is the launch import path.
AI, agent, and automation history exports belong to their owning modules.
Commercial audit-export entitlement supply remains 10A; production defaults to denied.
Email capture is unresolved under OD-29; 6A lists email_inbound as not configured and creates no address, inbound mail, or sender verification.

corrections: 6C: closure claims that rested on reserved fields, ADR prose, or placeholder text now cite running behavior and tests (closure-6c corrections).
6A: closure normalized to the standard schema with evidence and contributions; INT-010 (6B) and INT-026 (6C) closed once by their owners.
Identifiers: duplicate pl-42 (6B) renumbered to PL-43; ADR-42/AZ-42 written for 6C; AT-315/AT-316 registered.
Policies: 0047 and 0050 tenant policies moved to exec.current_workspace_id() with WITH CHECK in migration 0051.
Web: the API tokens page read the wrong envelope level and failed on load; fixed with webhook settings added.
MCP provenance: 0049 widened audit and capture source kinds but not core.record, so every MCP-created record failed; 0051 adds `mcp` with a rollback that relabels to `api`.
6A HTTP: sync and conflict-resolve routes wrapped resource data in a non-resource envelope (500); fixed with an HTTP regression test.

6B: brand-scoped webhook subscriptions were visible to administrators without the brand; duplicate internal events created duplicate deliveries; overlapping sweeps re-sent deliveries. Fixed under AT-331/AT-336.
6E: listing clients failed for members (ambiguous column) and pm.tasks.complete always failed; 6D: a malformed job id raised a raw database error; connection purge failed for calendar connections.

Corrective review 01 (webhooks): delivery authorized at send through the canonical record predicate as the accountable owner (not brand access), exact brand matching, explicit tombstone contract, schema-correct envelope with the original event time, replay as a guarded transition for dead letters only, a user pause/resume with an honest in-flight boundary, per-placement management for brand managers, and subscription writes moved out of the send transaction (a deadlock under overlapping workers). Migration 0052.
